name: hypertask_reports
does: List, read, create, update or delete saved HTML reports on a board, read the board speed report as numbers, or draft the board status update from those numbers.
use_when: Use for a persistent board report rather than an ephemeral answer.
do_not_use_when: Do not use to compute time totals or to edit ordinary pages; use hypertask_time report or hypertask_pages instead.
parameters_and_caveats: action selects an operation, including velocity, which returns the board speed report numbers with no HTML, and status_update, which drafts and saves the board status update; input contains only that operation’s documented fields. response_format defaults to concise for reads; detailed retains full fields. limit defaults to 20 (maximum 50) and offset defaults to 0 for bounded read results; use returned pagination or narrower filters. Identifiers and required fields depend on the selected action; writes keep existing authorization and confirmation rules.
